name: Makereba Kanojo ga Zukobako Batsu Game
original_name: 負ければ彼女がズコバコ罰ゲーム
source: When the protagonist's brother defaults on a debt of 100 million yen, the loan sharks come after him! But, thanks to his pretty girlfriend, he's offered a chance to earn the money by participating in a quiz show. For each right answer, he earns money, but each wrong answer puts his girlfriend in dire straits...
translation: 主人公的哥哥拖欠1亿日元债务后，放贷者找上门来！但多亏漂亮女友，他获得了参加问答节目的机会，可以赚取还款所需的钱。每答对一题就能赚钱，但每答错一题，女友就会陷入危急境地……
